allow_remote.description: Allow remote connections to the daemon.

daemon_port.description: Port the daemon will listen on.

log_level.description: Set the log level (none, info, warning, error, debug). Default is error.

max_active_downloading.description: Maximum number of torrents allowed to be actively downloading at once.

max_active_seeding.description: Maximum number of torrents allowed to be actively seeding at once.

max_download_speed.description: Maximum download speed (in KB/s). 0 means unlimited.

max_upload_speed.description: Maximum upload speed (in KB/s). 0 means unlimited.

max_connections_global.description: Maximum total number of connections across all torrents.

seed_time.description: Seed time limit in minutes (0 means unlimited).

listen_interfaces.description: Interface daemon will listen for bittorrent connections on.

user.description: Change to this user on startup (Requires root).

pidfile.description: Pidfile to store the process id.

logfile.description: Output to specified logfile instead of stdout.
